description: change of use of the ground floor of 25 High street from a former bank (Class E) to an Adult Gaming Centre (Sui Generis) to extend their existing unit at no. 23 High Street.
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
No amplified speech, public address systems, or music shall be used on the premises at any time, with the exception of low level background music only.

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;</p><p>923-EX-001 Rev 00, 923-PL-101 Rev 01, Site Location Plan, Site Plan, Footfall, Pedestrian Flow and Linked Trip Surveys (Merkut Slots UK), Noise Assessment (PR2001_225_FINAL_R1 - Merkur Slots UK Limited (17/10/2025), Planning Statement (Planning Potential Oct 25), CIL Form 1&nbsp;</p>

<p>Prior to first use of the amalgamated premises, a post completion sound insulation test shall be undertaken to demonstrate that the approved mitigation measures are effective in preventing noise transmission to the residential accommodation above. The results shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.</p>

<p>The amalgamated premises shall be operated in full accordance with the approved Noise Report (Ref: PR2001_225_FINAL_R1), including all mitigation measures and the Operational Management Plan. All identified mitigation measures shall be fully implemented prior to first use of the amalgamated premises and thereafter retained for the lifetime of the development.</p>
<p>During night time hours (23:00–07:00), all external doors and windows shall be kept closed, except for access and egress.</p>

<p>Any fixed plant, machinery, air conditioning, or ventilation equipment installed at the premises shall be designed, installed, and operated such that the rating level of noise emitted does not exceed 10 dB below the prevailing background noise level (LA90) at the nearest noise sensitive receptor, when assessed in accordance with BS 4142.</p>

The development hereby permitted shall not commence until a scheme for the storage and disposal of refuse/waste has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority.  The development shall not be occupied or used until the works have been completed in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.

<p>Prior to the first occupation of the development, the applicant shall apply for a Secured by Design Certification which shall be submitted and approved in writing by the local planning authority, or justification shall be submitted where the accreditation requirements cannot be met. Secure by design measures shall be implemented where practical and the development shall be retained in accordance with the approved details.</p>
